guide.summary: Words like 见面, 睡觉, 结婚 and 帮忙 look like one verb but are really verb + object (见 'see' + 面 'face'). The object slot is already full, so no second object can follow, and everything that normally sits between a verb and its object (了, 过, a duration, a count, 完, 的-phrases) goes in the middle of the word. Treat 睡觉 like 吃饭 and the rules fall out.

subs.label: No object after it: 跟他见面
subs.focus: The learner must decide where the other person or place goes: never after the word (见面他, 结婚她, 毕业大学, 出差上海) but before the verb (跟他见面, 向她道歉, 大学毕业, 去上海出差). Classic mistake: copying English 'meet him', 'marry her'. Never treat 担心 + object as wrong: 担心他 is correct.

subs.label: Person inside with 的: 帮他的忙, 生我的气
subs.focus: With 帮忙 and 生气 the person affected goes inside as 'person + 的': 帮我的忙, 生他的气. The learner must reject 帮忙我 and 生气我. Accept the alternatives 帮我 (plain 帮 takes an object), 给他帮忙 and 跟他生气, so never offer two of these as competing options in one item.

subs.label: 了 / 过 / 着 inside: 见过面
subs.focus: 过 and 着 attach to the verb half, not to the whole word: 见过面, 结过婚, 请过假, 说着话. Verb 了 also goes inside when the sentence continues or something is counted (吃了饭就走). Classic mistake: 见面过, 结婚过, 请假过. Sentence-final 了 after the whole word (他结婚了, 我们放假了) is correct and must never be marked wrong.

subs.label: Duration inside: 睡了八个小时觉
subs.focus: How long the action lasted goes between the two halves, after 了: 睡了八个小时(的)觉, 请了三天假, or the verb is repeated: 睡觉睡了八个小时. Classic mistake: 睡觉了八个小时, 游泳了一个小时. Also test the opposite case: point-like words (结婚, 毕业, 离婚) put the time since after the whole word: 结婚十年了, not 结了十年婚.

subs.label: 次 / 个 inside: 见过一次面, 洗个澡
subs.focus: Number of times and the casual 个 go inside: 见过两次面, 结过两次婚, 洗了一个澡, 开了三个会, 帮我一个忙. The learner must place 次/个 between the halves. Classic mistake: 见面过两次, 洗澡了一个, 结婚过两次.

subs.label: Double only the verb: 散散步
subs.focus: For 'do a bit of' only the first half doubles: 散散步, 聊聊天, 帮帮忙, 见见面, 洗洗澡. Classic mistake: doubling the whole word like an ordinary two-syllable verb (散步散步, 聊天聊天), by analogy with 休息休息 and 学习学习. Items may contrast a separable verb with a normal one.

subs.label: 得 needs the verb again: 唱歌唱得很好
subs.focus: 得 must touch a verb, so the verb is repeated after the object (唱歌唱得很好, 游泳游得很快) or the object is said first and the verb once (歌唱得很好). Classic mistake: 唱歌得很好, 跳舞得很漂亮, 睡觉得很晚.

subs.label: 完 / 好 / 不着 / 什么 inside: 吃完饭
subs.focus: Result words, potential forms and 什么 also go between the halves: 吃完饭, 上完课, 洗完澡, 没睡好觉, 睡不着觉, 生什么气. Classic mistake: 吃饭完, 上课完, 洗澡完, 睡觉不着, 生气什么.

rules.rule: The word already contains its object, so the other person cannot follow it. Bring the person in before the verb with 跟 or 和.
rules.pattern: Subject + 跟 / 和 + person + verb-object

examples.py: wǒ míng tiān gēn péng you jiàn miàn
examples.en: I'm meeting a friend tomorrow.

examples.zh: 他去年和女朋友结婚了。
examples.py: tā qù nián hé nǚ péng you jié hūn le
examples.en: He married his girlfriend last year.

examples.py: wǒ xǐ huan gēn tóng xué liáo tiān
examples.en: I like chatting with my classmates.

examples.py: nǐ wèi shén me gēn dì di dǎ jià
examples.en: Why did you fight with your little brother?

rules.note: 跟 and 和 are interchangeable here. This covers 见面, 结婚, 离婚, 聊天, 握手, 打架, 说话, 跳舞, 吃饭, 散步.

rules.rule: Some of these words pick a different word before the verb: 向 or 跟 for apologising, 给 for helping or applauding, 去 + place for a business trip, and the school simply goes in front of 毕业.
rules.pattern: Subject + 向 / 给 / 去 / 从 + person or place + verb-object

examples.py: nǐ yīng gāi xiàng tā dào qiàn
examples.en: You should apologise to her.

examples.zh: 爸爸下个星期去上海出差。
examples.py: bà ba xià gè xīng qī qù shàng hǎi chū chāi
examples.en: Dad is going to Shanghai on business next week.

examples.zh: 我哥哥去年大学毕业了。
examples.py: wǒ gē ge qù nián dà xué bì yè le
examples.en: My older brother graduated from university last year.

examples.py: dà jiā dōu gěi tā gǔ zhǎng
examples.en: Everyone applauded him.

rules.note: 担心 is the exception in this family: it freely takes an object (别担心我, 我很担心他的身体). Written Chinese also has 毕业于 + school, but 毕业大学 is wrong.

rules.rule: With 帮忙 and 生气 the person goes inside the word as 'person + 的'. Plain 帮 can take the person directly, but 帮忙 cannot.
rules.pattern: Subject + 帮 / 生 + person + 的 + 忙 / 气

examples.py: xiè xie nǐ bāng le wǒ de máng
examples.en: Thank you for helping me out.

examples.py: mā ma hái zài shēng wǒ de qì
examples.en: Mum is still angry with me.

examples.py: nǐ bié shēng tā de qì le
examples.en: Stop being angry with him.

examples.py: zhōu mò wǒ qù gěi péng you bāng máng
examples.en: I'm going to help a friend out this weekend.

rules.note: Also correct: 你能帮我吗 (帮 alone), 给他帮忙, 跟他生气. Only 帮忙我 and 生气我 are wrong.

rules.rule: 过 and 着 go right after the verb half. Verb 了 goes there too when the sentence carries on or a number follows. Negative: 没 + verb + 过 + object.
rules.pattern: Subject + verb + 了 / 过 / 着 + object

examples.py: wǒ men yǐ qián jiàn guo miàn
examples.en: We have met before.

examples.py: tā cóng lái méi qǐng guo jià
examples.en: He has never taken leave.

examples.py: wǒ chī le fàn jiù qù zhǎo nǐ
examples.en: I'll come and find you as soon as I've eaten.

examples.zh: 他们正说着话，老师进来了。
examples.py: tā men zhèng shuō zhe huà lǎo shī jìn lái le
examples.en: They were talking when the teacher came in.

rules.note: 了 at the very end of the sentence after the whole word is normal and correct: 他结婚了, 我们放假了, 她生气了. You may hear 见面过 in casual speech, but the standard form is 见过面.

rules.rule: How long an activity lasted goes between the two halves, after 了; 的 before the object is optional. Or say the whole word, then repeat the verb with the duration.
rules.pattern: Subject + verb + 了 + duration + (的) + object

examples.zh: 我昨天睡了八个小时觉。
examples.py: wǒ zuó tiān shuì le bā gè xiǎo shí jiào
examples.en: I slept for eight hours yesterday.

examples.zh: 我们聊了一个下午的天。
examples.py: wǒ men liáo le yī gè xià wǔ de tiān
examples.en: We chatted for a whole afternoon.

examples.py: tā shàng gè yuè qǐng le sān tiān jià
examples.en: He took three days off last month.

examples.py: tā yóu yǒng yóu le bàn gè xiǎo shí
examples.en: She swam for half an hour.

rules.note: Never put the duration after the unsplit word with 了: 睡觉了八个小时 is wrong.

rules.rule: 结婚, 毕业 and 离婚 happen at a point and do not last. To say how long it has been since, put the time after the whole word and end with 了.

examples.py: tā men jié hūn shí nián le
examples.en: They have been married for ten years.

examples.py: wǒ dà xué bì yè liǎng nián le
examples.en: It's been two years since I graduated from university.

examples.py: tā men lí hūn yǐ jīng sān nián le
examples.en: They have been divorced for three years already.

rules.note: 放假 can go either way with a different meaning: 我们放了三天假 (the holiday lasted three days), 我们放假三天了 (we have been on holiday for three days now).

rules.rule: The number of times (次) and the casual 个 go inside, after 了 or 过 if there is one.
rules.pattern: Subject + verb + (了 / 过) + number + 次 / 个 + object

examples.py: wǒ men zhǐ jiàn guo liǎng cì miàn
examples.en: We have only met twice.

examples.py: tā jié guo liǎng cì hūn
examples.en: He has been married twice.

examples.py: wǒ xiǎng xiān xǐ gè zǎo
examples.en: I'd like to take a shower first.

examples.py: nǐ néng bāng wǒ yī gè máng ma
examples.en: Can you do me a favour?

rules.note: 个 here does not really count; it makes the action sound light and casual (洗个澡, 睡个觉, 理个发, 开个会).

rules.rule: To say 'do a bit of it', double only the verb half. Ordinary two-syllable verbs double as a whole (休息休息), separable ones never do.

examples.zh: 吃完饭我们出去散散步吧。
examples.py: chī wán fàn wǒ men chū qù sàn sàn bù ba
examples.en: Let's go out for a little walk after dinner.

examples.py: yǒu kòng lái wǒ jiā liáo liáo tiān
examples.en: Come over for a chat when you're free.

examples.py: qǐng nǐ bāng bāng máng
examples.en: Please lend a hand.

examples.zh: 周末我喜欢在家唱唱歌。
examples.py: zhōu mò wǒ xǐ huan zài jiā chàng chàng gē
examples.en: At weekends I like to sing a bit at home.

rules.note: Only casual, deliberate activities double. 结婚, 毕业, 离婚, 生气 and 出差 are not doubled at all. For a finished action 了 goes between the two verbs: 我们昨天聊了聊天.

rules.rule: 得 must come straight after a verb, never after the object half. Say the whole word, then repeat the verb before 得; or put the object first and say the verb once.

examples.py: tā chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎo
examples.en: She sings very well.

examples.py: tā yóu yǒng yóu de hěn kuài
examples.en: He swims very fast.

examples.py: wǒ zuó tiān shuì jiào shuì de hěn wǎn
examples.en: I went to bed very late last night.

examples.py: tā wǔ tiào de fēi cháng hǎo
examples.en: She dances extremely well.

rules.note: Negation goes in the description, not before the verb: 他唱歌唱得不好.

rules.rule: Result words (完, 好), potential forms (不着, 不了) and 什么 go right after the verb half, before the object half.
rules.pattern: Subject + verb + 完 / 好 / 不着 / 什么 + object

examples.zh: 我吃完饭就给你打电话。
examples.py: wǒ chī wán fàn jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
examples.en: I'll call you as soon as I finish eating.

examples.zh: 上完课我们一起去吃饭吧。
examples.py: shàng wán kè wǒ men yī qǐ qù chī fàn ba
examples.en: Let's go and eat together after class.

examples.py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang méi shuì hǎo jiào
examples.en: I didn't sleep well last night.

examples.py: nǐ shēng shén me qì
examples.en: What are you angry about?

rules.note: Same shape as an ordinary verb and object: 吃完饭 is built exactly like 看完书.

right.py: wǒ míng tiān gēn tā jiàn miàn

contrasts.why: 面 already fills the object slot of 见, so 他 cannot follow. The person comes before the verb with 跟.

right.zh: 他跟一个中国人结婚了。
right.py: tā gēn yī gè zhōng guó rén jié hūn le

contrasts.why: English 'marry someone' has an object; 结婚 does not take one. You get married 'with' someone: 跟 + person + 结婚.

right.py: nǐ néng bāng wǒ yī gè máng ma
right.en: Can you do me a favour?

contrasts.why: 帮忙 cannot take 我 after it. Split it (帮我一个忙, 帮我的忙) or use plain 帮: 你能帮我吗.

right.py: tā shēng wǒ de qì le

contrasts.why: The person you are angry with goes inside 生气 as 我的: literally 'she produced my anger'.
过 attaches to the verb 见, not to the noun 面, just as in 吃过饭.

right.py: wǒ shuì le bā gè xiǎo shí jiào

contrasts.why: 了 and the duration follow the verb 睡 and come before the object 觉. 睡觉睡了八个小时 also works.

right.py: tā jié guo liǎng cì hūn

contrasts.why: 过 and the count 两次 belong inside 结婚: 结 + 过 + 两次 + 婚.

right.py: wǒ men chū qù sàn sàn bù ba
right.en: Let's go out for a little walk.

contrasts.why: Only the verb half doubles. 散步散步 treats 散步 like 休息, but 步 is its object.

right.py: tā chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎo

contrasts.why: 得 cannot follow the noun 歌. Repeat the verb so that 得 sits right after 唱.

right.py: wǒ xǐ wán zǎo jiù shuì jiào
right.en: I'll go to bed as soon as I've had my shower.

contrasts.why: The result word 完 attaches to the verb 洗, before the object 澡, like 吃完饭.

cheat: A person after 见面, 结婚, 聊天, 道歉？ Move them in front with 跟 / 和 / 向.
帮忙 and 生气 + person: put 'person + 的' in the middle (帮我的忙, 生他的气).
过, 着, 完, 好, 什么: right after the first character (见过面, 吃完饭).
How long or how many times: verb + 了 + amount + object (睡了八个小时觉, 见过两次面).
结婚, 毕业, 离婚 + time since: whole word first, then the time, then 了 (结婚十年了).
'A bit of': double the first character only (散散步, 聊聊天).
得 must touch a verb: 唱歌唱得好, never 唱歌得好.
